long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The bowl is empty and my restlessness needs somewhere to go, so I will run it off here at dusk.
Once I have run it off, the bed is soft and near the water, so I will claim it for the evening.
I will curl up on the bed and wait for morning, when the bowl is filled again and nobody gets to tell me otherwise.

today.reason: The bowl is empty until I wake, so I will spend the evening running off restlessness and then resting on the bed.
